title: Certificate of compliance for computer-generated evidence
ruleSource: Written from S.A Badmus' Criminal Litigation drafts (Lawdeck knowledge base). To be confirmed by the legal reviewer, including every statutory provision cited.

parts.why: The heading of the court where the evidence is tendered. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
The case number and the parties, as in the proceedings. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text: CERTIFICATE OF COMPUTER-GENERATED EVIDENCE PURSUANT TO SECTION 84 OF THE EVIDENCE ACT 2011
parts.why: Section 84 of the Evidence Act 2011 makes a computer print-out admissible only with a certificate covering the conditions of the section. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

parts.text:
I, {{certifier}}, {{certifierDescription}}, of {{certifierAddress}}, do hereby certify that:
#. This certificate is made in respect of the following electronic evidence: {{evidence}}.
#. The documents were produced by the computer {{computer}}, which was used regularly to store and process information for the activities regularly carried on over that period.
#. Throughout the material part of that period the computer was operating properly.
#. The information contained in the documents reproduces, or is derived from, information supplied to the computer in the ordinary course of those activities, and the print-outs were not affected in their production.
parts.why: Identifies the evidence and the computer, and certifies the conditions of section 84: regular use, proper operation, and information supplied in the ordinary course. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).
Signed and sworn before a Commissioner for Oaths. Source: Criminal Litigation drafting materials (Lawdeck knowledge base).

fields.label: Court heading
fields.question: The full heading of the court, for example: IN THE HIGH COURT OF LAGOS STATE, IN THE IKEJA JUDICIAL DIVISION, HOLDEN AT IKEJA.

fields.label: Case number and parties
fields.question: The case number and parties, for example: CHARGE NO: ID/12/2024, THE STATE OF LAGOS v JOHN OKON.

fields.label: Person certifying
fields.question: Who makes the certificate? The person responsible for the computer.

fields.label: Description
fields.question: Describe them: sex, occupation and role.

fields.label: Electronic evidence
fields.question: What documents or records does the certificate cover?

fields.label: Computer
fields.question: Which computer or device produced them? For example: an HP laptop.

fields.label: Registry
fields.question: Where is it sworn? For example: High Court Registry, Ikeja.
